summary: Frontend testing of enhanced influencer table features completed. All new features working correctly: sortable columns, advanced filters panel, results count summary, row click navigation, and checkbox comparison selection.

issues: Recharts container showing width(-1) height(-1) warnings - cosmetic console warnings, charts render correctly
Industry and Gender columns show '-' for most influencers as data was not populated - this is expected data issue, not UI bug

passed_tests: Enhanced table displays new columns: Followers (formatted K/M), Eng. %, Industry, Tier, Gender, Status, Score, Updated
Column sorting by Followers - shows 'Sorted by Followers (desc)', highest followers at top
Column sorting by Engagement Rate - shows 'Sorted by Engagement Rate (desc)'
Column sorting by Name - alphabetical sorting
Column sorting by Score - default sort
Sortable column headers have gold highlight and arrow indicators
Advanced filters button opens filter panel
Advanced filters panel shows: Industry, Gender, Tier, Platform dropdowns
Advanced filters panel shows: Engagement Rate range (0%-20%)
Advanced filters panel shows: Followers range (0-10M+)
Tier filter (Micro) correctly shows 'Showing 3 of 8 influencers'
Results summary shows correct 'Showing X of Y influencers' count
Clear All button clears all advanced filters
Filter button shows count of active filters e.g., '(1)'
Selecting 2+ influencers shows 'Compare (X)' button in header
Row click navigates to influencer profile page (/influencers/:id)
Influencer profile page loads correctly with all details

checkbox_comparison.details: Checkboxes select influencers for comparison. 'Compare (X)' button appears when 2+ selected.
